scientific_integrity: New claim is the exact second-order two-spin-flip component graph and spectral selection; reproducible complete enumerator included. Historical priority remains subject to specialist comparison. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite 60-site classical Ising and order-two uniform transverse-field effective Hamiltonian only; no finite-field exact sector decoupling. title: Eleven second-order tunneling sectors in the antiferromagnetic \(C_{60}\) Ising cage
